# DeepWiki

> > AI-powered conversational documentation platform that transforms GitHub repositories into interactive, queryable knowledge bases

DeepWiki provides AI-enhanced documentation for open source projects, covering everything from enterprise systems and machine learning frameworks to IoT devices and developer tools. The platform indexes repositories spanning Python, Node.js, Java, and other technologies, making complex codebases accessible through natural language interaction.

## Key Topics

- AI documentation
- GitHub repositories
- Python frameworks
- Node.js applications
- API documentation
- CLI tools
- Web scraping
- Docker containers
- OpenAI integration
- Firebase services
- Active Directory security
- IoT and ESP32
- Machine learning models
- E-commerce systems
- Real-time data processing

## Platform Overview

- [DeepWiki Home](https://deepwiki.com): AI-powered conversational documentation platform for GitHub repositories

## AI and Machine Learning

- [01-ai/Yi](https://deepwiki.com/01-ai/Yi): Yi bilingual large language model family by 01.AI with Docker support
- [0235-jp/Claude-Code-Server](https://deepwiki.com/0235-jp/Claude-Code-Server): HTTP gateway providing OpenAI API-compatible access to Claude CLI
- [0010skn/daletou](https://deepwiki.com/0010skn/daletou): AI-powered Chinese Super Lotto analysis and prediction system

## Enterprise and E-Commerce Systems

- [01-Java/mall](https://deepwiki.com/01-Java/mall): E-commerce system with Nuxt frontend and Spring Boot backend monorepo
- [01101sam/Cloudreve](https://deepwiki.com/01101sam/Cloudreve): Self-hosted file management system with multi-cloud and WebDAV support
- [007gzs/meeting](https://deepwiki.com/007gzs/meeting): Django meeting room booking system with WeChat mini-program integration
- [00labs/huma-contracts](https://deepwiki.com/00labs/huma-contracts): Huma Protocol Solidity smart contracts for credit pools and factoring

## Security and Network Tools

- [000pp/hexodus](https://deepwiki.com/000pp/hexodus): Python framework for Active Directory enumeration via LDAP, SMB, and RPC
- [03/ONVIF-Java](https://deepwiki.com/03/ONVIF-Java): Java library for ONVIF IP camera control, PTZ operations, and streaming
- [00xdF/halcon_plate_recognize](https://deepwiki.com/00xdF/halcon_plate_recognize): Halcon-based license plate recognition with OCR for .NET Framework

## Developer Tools and Libraries

- [07akioni/lyla](https://deepwiki.com/07akioni/lyla): TypeScript HTTP client library with platform adapters for mini-programs
- [00frank/dolarhoy-cli](https://deepwiki.com/00frank/dolarhoy-cli): CLI tool for real-time Argentine peso exchange rates using Node.js scraping
- [0000gde/-SQlite3](https://deepwiki.com/0000gde/-SQlite3): Python SQLite3 tutorial demonstrating basic database operations

## IoT and Embedded Systems

- [0015/ThatProject](https://deepwiki.com/0015/ThatProject): ESP32/ESP8266 IoT projects collection with LVGL UI and sensor apps
- [00-Evan/pixel-dungeon-gradle](https://deepwiki.com/00-Evan/pixel-dungeon-gradle): Pixel Dungeon game engine with OpenGL wrapper and shader system

## Educational and Utility Projects

- [01Brxyan/Proyecto_Python_Castro1Brayan1Navas2Andres2](https://deepwiki.com/01Brxyan/Proyecto_Python_Castro1Brayan1Navas2Andres2): CampusLands academic management system for student lifecycle tracking
- [02BBQ/FishServer](https://deepwiki.com/02BBQ/FishServer): Node.js fish catching simulation with Firebase and inventory management
- [0707rf/TDTA_bot](https://deepwiki.com/0707rf/TDTA_bot): Taiwan driving test appointment automation bot for Motor Vehicle Office
- [01Brxyan/Trabajo-de-cuenta-bancaria](https://deepwiki.com/01Brxyan/Trabajo-de-cuenta-bancaria): Educational Python console banking system for account management
